text_block_list.text:
The eventful summer training camp
has finally come to an end—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I just can't get used to this. Just like last year, it's so hard to say goodbye.
choice_data_list: That just shows what a great training camp it was.
That just shows what a great training camp it was.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...If possible,
I would love to come here again someday.
And when that time comes—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ah, looks like the bus is here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Shall we head back to the academy, Trainer?

Summer training camp has ended,
and the Mainichi Okan is right around the corner—
